Physical Intelligence opens robot-model API beta

Developers can fine-tune on PI-managed infrastructure and access hosted inference, with admission in batches.

Humanoids Daily ↗13 October 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 1

Managed training infrastructure

Physical Intelligence announced its API beta on October 13. Teams upload demonstrations, fine-tune using PI-managed compute and access models through a hosted inference gateway, reducing infrastructure work for robot developers.

Iteration still needs real data

Developers must test on hardware and collect new examples around failures. PI cites Almond’s dual-arm Axol deburring its own assembly spacers after four days of API iteration; this does not establish a four-day training time for every task.

Limited initial access

The beta starts small and requires an application. Most demonstrations used cloud inference, with connectivity challenges in some applications. Questions about local inference in the application form do not establish availability of a local deployment service.
